lines.native: ¡Hola! Todo es jamón. Even the hat. Certified ham-tier quality! ¿Qué quieres? These scales await greatness.
lines.translation: Hello! Everything is ham. Even the hat. Certified ham-tier quality! What would you like? These scales await greatness.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams behind his stall. He sets his hat on the scales, giving it the same professional respect as the sausages.

lines.native: ¡Jamón, claro! But that is everything here. Necesito otro nombre. What meat would you like? Mi sombrero no cuenta. Certified ham, strictly display-only.
lines.translation: Ham, of course! But that is everything here. I need another name. What meat would you like? My hat does not count. Certified ham, strictly display-only.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales confirm that it contains no surprises.

lines.native: ¡Chorizo, correcto! Me gusta tu precisión. ¿Cuánto quieres llevar? This certified jamón awaits a quantity with a weight unit. My scales accept no vibes.
lines.translation: Chorizo, correct! I like your precision. How much would you like to take? This certified ham awaits a quantity with a weight unit. My scales accept no vibes.
lines.narrative: Mortimer beams, then weighs his approval. The scales register nothing; he blames modesty.

lines.native: ¡Falta la cantidad! La unidad sola no basta. ¿Cuánto chorizo quieres llevar? My scales need an amount with that weight unit. Even certified ham requires paperwork.
lines.translation: The amount is missing! The unit alone is not enough. How much chorizo would you like? My scales need an amount with that weight unit. Even certified ham requires paperwork.
lines.narrative: Mortimer removes his hat from the scales. It has contributed weight, but no expertise.

lines.native: ¡Medio kilo, perfecto! Aquí tienes tu chorizo. Muchas gracias. Certified jamón, correctly weighed! My scales approve. ¡Hasta luego! Your precision has a ham-tier vibe.
lines.translation: Half a kilo, perfect! Here is your chorizo. Thank you very much. Certified ham, correctly weighed! My scales approve. See you later! Your precision has a ham-tier vibe.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the chorizo, then your achievement. Both satisfy the scales; only one goes in the wrapping.

lines.native: ¡Amigo mío! Qué bueno verte. Tengo miedo. I have never asked a jamón for permission before slicing it. Hungry sailors in an old story roasted beasts they had sworn not to touch. ¿Soy como ellos? This is not a certified-ham moment.
lines.translation: My friend! Good to see you. I am afraid. I have never asked a ham for permission before slicing it. Hungry sailors in an old story roasted beasts they had sworn not to touch. Am I like them? This is not a certified-ham moment.
lines.narrative: At the market entrance, Mortimer’s knife trembles over the hamper. He places it on his scales, which have never claimed to weigh guilt but are about to be consulted.

lines.native: ¡Gracias, amigo! Pero tengo miedo. Your English reassurance is ham-adjacent; I need the Spanish word for calm. ¿Me ayudas? This knife has opinions.
lines.translation: Thank you, friend! But I am afraid. Your English reassurance is ham-adjacent; I need the Spanish word for calm. Will you help me? This knife has opinions.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your reassurance. The scales remain honest; the knife remains unhelpfully mobile.

lines.native: ¡Gracias! Estoy tranquilo. No toques las manadas sagradas, nunca. Give me your solemn promise: only ordinary, consenting jamón. My scales will witness this. ¿Me das tu palabra?
lines.translation: Thank you! I am calm. Never touch the sacred herds. Give me your solemn promise: only ordinary, consenting ham. My scales will witness this. Do you give me your word?
lines.narrative: Mortimer lowers his knife and places a hand on the scales, which have somehow become a notary.

lines.native: ¡Eso no es una promesa, amigo! Las manadas sagradas no se tocan. ¿Me das tu palabra? Only ordinary, consenting jamón. This commitment-free vibe is not certified ham.
lines.translation: That is not a promise, friend! The sacred herds must not be touched. Do you give me your word? Only ordinary, consenting ham. This commitment-free vibe is not certified ham.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your refusal. The scales remain honest, which is becoming inconvenient.

lines.native: ¡Muy bien! Tengo tu palabra. Las manadas sagradas están a salvo. Your promise is certified ham. My hat approves; premium jamón, excellent leadership.
lines.translation: Very good! I have your word. The sacred herds are safe. Your promise is certified ham. My hat approves; premium ham, excellent leadership.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your promise. The scales balance, having wisely declined to assess its grammar. He lowers the knife and salutes you with his hat, another recognised form of ham.
